SELECT
  channel,
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  MIN(order_date) AS first_order,
  MAX(order_date) AS last_order,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_amount), 2) AS gross_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (
    channel
  )
ORDER BY
  channel
